title: The Multilinear Self — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of The Multilinear Self's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. pieces.title: One thing, three true shadows
pieces.caption: “Each name is a projection of it — a real shadow the whole self casts into a particular room.” “Honest, just partial.” *What is real and what is a choice:* The solid is my stand-in for the whole self: a round base rising to a straight ridge, which does cast a circle, a rectangle and a triangle; the shadows are computed from it in one projection. Three of the page's six names are shown with the rooms its roster gives them. Which shape goes with which name means nothing. *Leaking in:* Hyperdimensional Prism: the page says the self “is the [[Hyperdimensional Prism]] turned on the person who made it”.
pieces.near: a real shadow the whole self casts

verdicts.file: The Multilinear Self — rich — one thing, three true shadows.svg
verdicts.why: The footer says "no shadow is a lie", and one is. The red solid is drawn as a cone, and a cone casts a circle and two triangles, never a rectangle. There is a solid that casts a circle, a rectangle and a triangle (a round base rising to a straight ridge, a cylinder cut to a wedge); draw that, with the ridge visible. The triangle on the right wall also lies on its side, pointing right, where an upright solid would cast it upright. Second: the rooms.

remade.file: The Multilinear Self — rich — one thing, three true shadows.svg
remade.what: The solid was a cone, which cannot cast a rectangle, the triangle lay on its side, the rooms came from the Jewel and the quotation swapped the page's dash for a colon. The solid is now one that casts all three, with the triangle upright, the rooms are the roster's own, and the quotation is exact.
